title: The hospital parking lot, iv
logline: Thursday. The vending machine in the lot's covered walkway. Wood buys the dog crackers. The strip's only interior all week is the machine's lit glass, and it's outside.

panels.composition: The lot's covered walkway at night, a vending machine lit blue-white, the H sign beyond. WOOD at the machine. BARNABY on the leash, looking at the glass.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a lit vending machine in a covered hospital walkway at night with a thin man in front of it and a small dog on a leash looking at the glass, a blue-H sign beyond

panels.composition: The glass: rows of crackers, chips, a coil turning. The dog's reflection in it.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, close-up of a vending machine's lit glass with rows of snacks and a small dog's reflection in it, a coil beginning to turn

panels.composition: The crackers dropping. Wood crouched at the flap. The dog's whole attention.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a thin man crouched retrieving crackers from a vending machine's flap while a small dog watches intently

panels.composition: The two of them on the walkway's bench, sharing crackers, the lit machine, the dark lot, the H. The building behind the machine, still not drawn — the machine is in front of it.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a thin man and a small dog sharing crackers on a bench beside a lit vending machine in a dark hospital lot at night, a blue-H sign, no building visible behind the machine, no words
image.notes: The machine stands where the building would be. Never the building.

art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays in watercolor, improving

notes: The vending machine: the week's only lit interior, and it's outdoors.
